description:
The rate-matched 5G NR LDPC code documents filler-position LLR initialization as $+\infty$, while de-rate-matching writes a finite prior.

## Background

The rustdoc of the NR rate-matched code constructor in `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/nr_5g/mod.rs` states that punctured positions get LLR 0 and filler positions get LLR $+\infty$. The de-rate-matching path writes the private constant `FILLER_LLR`, which is 15.0 and is documented at its definition as chosen to avoid `tanh` saturation in f32. A caller comparing gf2 with another implementation's filler convention reads the wrong contract from the public documentation.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The public documentation of NR rate-matched LLR preparation states the filler-position LLR value that the implementation writes, and the reason it is finite.
- [hard] REQ-02: The documented filler value and the value de-rate-matching writes derive from one source, so they cannot diverge silently.

## Notes

Surfaced by the protocol-v3 shift and coding-permutation baseline survey while mapping gf2 de-rate-matching onto an external implementation's filler convention.
title: Document the finite NR filler LLR that de-rate-matching writes
